listings.thesis: Highest-priority alpha screen: strong AI/CPO/advanced-packaging theme plus smaller or less fully penetrated market-cap base.

But the GF deal predates June 9 and the only new item, the June 15 AGM withdrawal and board resignations (founders + vice-chair out), is a governance flag that re-opens execution/validation risk on a ~1,945% YTD single-bundle name.
